env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

muxt generate --output-jsonv2 --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /signals datastar(sse(Feed(ctx, marshalJSON(sendSignals))))" -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.25
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	OK bool `json:"ok"`
}

// Feed sends one compact and one indented signals event: WithJSONOptions
// forwards jsontext encoder options to that event's marshal only.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Feed(_ context.Context, sendSignals func(s Sig, opts ...DatastarPatchSignalsOption) error) {
	_ = sendSignals(Sig{OK: true})
	_ = sendSignals(Sig{OK: true}, WithJSONOptions(jsontext.WithIndent("  ")))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/signals", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "data: signals {\"ok\":true}\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the compact signals event %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "data: signals {\ndata: signals   \"ok\": true\ndata: signals }\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the indented signals event %q", body, want)
	}
}
